brief.headline: AEGIS first launch: first-person view models in every crew seat, a 114-unit war across the whole landscape on three axes, and infantry that walk, aim and fall on an articulated rig.

items.text: Ray-Ban Display setup check, all claims fetched live from Meta's docs. Two real third-party paths onto the lens: Web Apps (standard HTML/CSS/JS rendered ON the glasses' display, fixed 600x600, Neural Band gestures arrive as arrow-key/Enter events, pure black renders transparent on the waveguide — AEGIS's holo-on-black aesthetic is accidentally native to this display) and the Device Access Toolkit (phone-hosted; glasses camera/mic/speakers plus a widget-and-MP4 display surface — NOT a framebuffer). Nothing supports casting the three.js demo to the lens; WebGL on-lens is undocumented and stays unpromised.

Recommended play for the Lockheed room: AEGIS UPLINK — a 600x600 dark-background companion Web App on the actual lens (mission ticker, target card, force strength), 2-4 days build, real third-party software on the Ray-Ban Display with no hand-waving. Floor: glasses as worn prop beside the tablet demo. Funded next step to pitch: DAT camera feed fused into the sat-uplink window (2-4+ weeks, native iOS, needs the org chain). Casting/mirroring: not possible, do not promise.

Hardware is the long pole, not software: Ray-Ban Display is US-only at $799, purchase requires a booked in-store demo appointment, international launch is paused, and waitlists have run well into 2026. Web Apps path needs no org — glasses + Developer Mode (five taps on the app version) + a hosted HTTPS URL. DAT path needs the one-per-company Managed Meta Account org created and owned.

AEGIS view models: enter any crew seat and you are holding something — rifle with iron sights, scoped M107, pintle .50 with a feeding belt, Apache canopy with glareshield MFDs, binoculars at the gun line. They sway with movement, kick with the unit's real recoil and muzzle-flash when it actually fires. Kept solid in both render modes deliberately: the weapon is the operator's hands, not part of the projection.

AEGIS theater-wide war: 114 units on three simultaneous axes — armour at the city, mech infantry in the hills, a recon screen on the flank — with fires in depth at the map edges whose 21/32 km reach covers every sector. Battle infantry now fight on foot on the articulated rig: walk on the advance, braced aim in contact, a fall about the feet when killed, rifle riding the hand throughout.

Playtested three full walk-in sessions end to end. Caught and fixed: battle stop() crashing on the new infantry rig fleets, view models eaten by the camera near plane, the holo wash rendering the weapon invisible, and table-scale civilians towering like giants over the metric battle from any eye-level camera (the crowd drops to metric scale whenever the camera is on the deck).

priorities.label: SENTINEL DEVELOPMENT
priorities.next: CI green, two hardening rounds merged. Next milestone (your steer): audit-chain tamper tests + central authorization-contract fuzzing.

tasks.title: AEGIS UPLINK — 600x600 companion Web App for the Ray-Ban lens
tasks.note: Dark-background DOM/SVG slice: mission ticker, target designation card, strike auth, force strength. Arrow-key/Enter navigation only. WebGL on-lens unverified — no 3D promised. Blocked on hardware + air-gap call.

tasks.title: Sentinel: audit-chain tamper tests
tasks.note: Proposed next milestone — verify the hash-chained audit log rejects reordered/edited/truncated events.

tasks.title: Sentinel: central authorization-contract fuzzing
tasks.note: Fuzz Scope.Decide / Policy.Authorize for scope-bypass regressions.

tasks.title: AEGIS: record cinematic capture for the pitch
tasks.note: ?autodemo runs the scripted loop (~3 min): strike, photoreal toggle, 4-target salvo, airdrop, team insert + sweep + waypoint move, UCAV, then a crew-POV pass. Press the button again to stop.

tasks.title: Configure ElevenLabs key for authentic JARVIS voice
tasks.note: Settings panel → key + voice ID. Falls back to en-GB system voice.

tasks.title: Fill in values.md + business.md knowledge base
tasks.note: jarvis/knowledge/ — the team checks decisions against it; blanks force escalations.

roadblocks.title: Ray-Ban Display hardware purchase (critical path)
roadblocks.impact: Nothing runs on-lens without the physical glasses. US-only, $799 incl. Neural Band, mandatory in-store demo appointment, waitlist risk into 2026.
roadblocks.proposed: Book the appointment now (Best Buy / LensCrafters / Sunglass Hut / Ray-Ban / select Verizon) so the wait runs in parallel with the build.

roadblocks.title: Air-gap exception for the on-lens companion app
roadblocks.impact: The glasses runtime physically requires a publicly hosted HTTPS URL; repo convention is air-gapped. The 600x600 AEGIS UPLINK slice cannot ship without one of them giving.
roadblocks.proposed: Approve password-protected HTTPS hosting (Developer Preview supports exactly this sharing mode) for the stripped companion slice only — the full demo stays air-gapped.

roadblocks.title: Managed Meta Account org (DAT path only)
roadblocks.impact: DAT distribution needs the one-per-company MMA org created and administered. Not needed for the Web Apps path.
roadblocks.proposed: Defer to post-meeting per iris's recommendation; decide owner when the DAT phase is funded.

roadblocks.title: No ElevenLabs credentials
roadblocks.impact: JARVIS speaks with the system en-GB voice instead of the cinematic one.
roadblocks.proposed: Paste key + voice ID in Settings (stored in this browser only).

roadblocks.title: Knowledge base is placeholder-only
roadblocks.impact: Decisions that aren't covered by values.md get escalated instead of resolved.
roadblocks.proposed: Fill in jarvis/knowledge/values.md and business.md when you have a moment.
